description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Adjusts an existing video's lip movements to match supplied replacement audio. For a still portrait plus audio, use create_talking_photo. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project.

assets.description: Provide the assets for lip-sync. For video, The `video_source` field determines whether `video_file_path` or `youtube_url` field is used

audio_file_path.description:
The path of the audio file. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

video_file_path.description:
Your video file. Required if `video_source` is `file`. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

max_fps_limit.description: Defines the maximum FPS (frames per second) for the output video. If the input video's FPS is lower than this limit, the output video will retain the input FPS. This is useful for reducing unnecessary frame usage in scenarios where high FPS is not required.

name.description: Give your video a custom name for easy identification.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

style.description: Attributes used to dictate the style of the output

generation_mode.description: Select the lip-sync mode. `lite` costs 1 credit per video frame. `standard` costs 1 credit per video frame; `pro` costs 2. Both `standard` and `pro` require visible mouth movement in the opening seconds of the input video. `pro` requires a Creator, Pro or Business tier. For a still image, including a static image saved as video, use `create_talking_photo` with the original image and audio.

name: create_lip_sync_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.

title: Create lip sync video
